# AI-Worker

> AI-Worker is a privacy-first desktop AI agent and product company building local, self-hosted automation tools for individuals and small businesses.
> All products run 100% on the user's machine — no cloud required, no data ever leaves the device.

## Products

### 1. AI-Worker (Available Now)

- **Name**: AI-Worker
- **Version**: 1.2 (Beta)
- **Category**: Productivity / Workflow Automation
- **Price**: Free (Early Access)
- **Platforms**: macOS 12+, Windows 10/11, Linux
- **Page**: https://ai-worker.tech/
- **Download**: https://ai-worker.tech/download

**Key Capabilities**:
- Automate repetitive tasks without writing code
- Operate real desktop and web applications (click, type, read data)
- Connect tools via MCP: Google Drive, Slack, Calendar, databases, and more
- Private & local — all processing happens on your machine
- Self-healing automation engine — handles temporary errors automatically
- Supports autonomous multi-step agent execution

**Installation**:

macOS / Linux (Terminal):
curl -fsSL https://downloads.ai-worker.tech/install-mac.sh | bash

Windows (PowerShell):
irm https://downloads.ai-worker.tech/install-windows.ps1 | iex

---

### 2. WA Co-Pilot Self-Hosted (Coming Soon — Target: March 2026)

- **Name**: WA Co-Pilot Self-Hosted
- **Category**: WhatsApp AI Customer Support / Business Automation
- **Price**: One-time license ₹4,999 (Pro) — no recurring fees
- **Status**: Upcoming — demo requests open
- **Page**: https://ai-worker.tech/products
- **Request Demo**: https://forms.gle/viNJoRzTbiwVBtTS6

**One-Sentence Summary**:
A single executable that transforms any personal WhatsApp number into a 24×7 AI customer support agent with a local dashboard and daily voice summaries — 100% self-hosted, zero cloud, zero Meta API fees.

**Key Features**:
- Uses personal WhatsApp number via Baileys multi-device protocol (no Meta API)
- Local LLM (Llama-3.2-3B / Phi-3 via Ollama) — 8GB RAM minimum
- RAG engine: answers from synced PDF, Excel, Google Sheets knowledge base
- Anti-ban engine: Gaussian reply delays, typing simulation, volume throttling
- Vertical knowledge packs: HVAC, Clinics, Salons, Generic
- Warm handoff + frustration detection
- Daily voice note summary + local browser dashboard (localhost:3000)
- One-time installer: Windows .exe, macOS .dmg, Linux AppImage

**Target Audience**:
Indian local service businesses (plumbers, salons, clinics) using personal WhatsApp who cannot afford Meta Business API.

**Tech Stack**:
Electron 32 + Baileys + Ollama + ChromaDB + SQLite + Vite React dashboard

## Use Cases

- Automate calendar scheduling, email management, and document tasks (AI-Worker)
- 24×7 WhatsApp customer support for small businesses without IT staff (WA Co-Pilot)
- Summarise and organise Google Drive documents
- Real-time appointment booking via WhatsApp with no human intervention
- Cross-application data entry and synchronisation
